description: This file contains functions for managing and reading I/O cgroup statistics and configurations, including setting I/O parameters, checking kernel support, and parsing cgroup v2 io.stat files.

methods.name: isIoSet
methods.description: Checks if any I/O resource limits are set in the cgroups.Resources.

methods.name: bfqDeviceWeightSupported
methods.description: Checks for per-device BFQ weight support by reading from 'io.bfq.weight'.

methods.name: setIo
methods.description: Configures I/O limits and scheduling for a cgroup based on Resources.

methods.name: readCgroup2MapFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a cgroup v2 map file into a map of string slices.

methods.name: statIo
methods.description: Reads and parses I/O statistics from 'io.stat' in a cgroup v2 filesystem.
